# Transactions (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Transactions` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 1 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-transactions) | `GET /transactions?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&FromDate={FromDate}&ToDate={ToDate}&Account={Account}` |


## Transactions

Path: `/transactions`

### Available fields for Transactions
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TaskID`  | Guid           |         ||Task ID     |
|`DebitAccountCode`|String|||Debit Account.|
|`CreditAccountCode`|String|||Credit Account.|
|`Amount`|Decimal|||Amount.|
|`EffectiveDate`|DateTime|||Transaction Date|
|`Reference`|String|||Custom Reference|
|`Transaction`|String|||Transaction description.|
|`Type`|String|||Transaction Type. Available values are `Purchase`,`Sale`,`MoneySpend`,`MoneyReceive`,`BankTransfer`,`ExpenseClaimTask`,`FinishedGoods`,`InventoryWriteOff`,`StockTake`,`StockAdjustment`,`Journal`,`Disassembly`,`Depreciation`|

<a id="get-transactions"></a>
### GET /transactions?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&FromDate={FromDate}&ToDate={ToDate}&Account={Account}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100. (Default: 100)
- `FromDate` (optional): Only return Transactions with EffectiveDate more than FromDate (Default: null)
- `ToDate` (optional): Only return Transactions with EffectiveDate less than ToDate (Default: null)
- `Account` (optional): Only return Transactions filtered by debit or credit account code (Default: null)
